mapper.select: SELECT i.tenant_id,i.id,i.task_id,i.step_id,i.attempt_id,i.ordinal,i.slot,i.provider_id,i.effect_intent_id,i.tool,i.plugin_version,i.plugin_digest,i.installation_epoch,i.input_snapshot,i.input_digest,i.state,i.output_snapshot,i.output_digest,i.projection_version,i.updated_at,i.record_version,i.todo_expected_revision,i.todo_applied_revision,i.todo_committed_attempt_id,i.todo_committed_fence,i.todo_event_seq,i.todo_committed_at,s.state AS step_state,s.record_version AS step_version,s.response_snapshot,s.response_digest,s.task_id AS step_task,s.ordinal AS step_ordinal FROM invocation i JOIN step s ON s.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND s.id=i.step_id WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND i.task_id=#{task} AND i.step_id=#{step} AND i.slot=#{slot}
SELECT state FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND step_id=#{step} AND slot=#{slot}
SELECT i.id FROM invocation i JOIN step s ON s.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND s.id=i.step_id WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND i.task_id=#{task} AND s.ordinal<#{ordinal} AND i.state<>'SUCCEEDED' LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,step_id,attempt_id,ordinal,slot,provider_id,effect_intent_id,tool,plugin_version,plugin_digest,installation_epoch,input_snapshot,input_digest,state,output_snapshot,output_digest,projection_version,updated_at,record_version,todo_expected_revision,todo_applied_revision,todo_committed_attempt_id,todo_committed_fence,todo_event_seq,todo_committed_at FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND id=#{invocation}
mapper.update: UPDATE invocation SET state='SUCCEEDED',output_snapshot=#{output},output_digest=#{digest} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{invocation} AND state='PENDING'
